_comment: Self-contained Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer-style example, not a validated printer preset. Replace the bed, nozzle, limits and start/end G-code for your printer. No inherited files are required. Import a filament profile separately.
name: Example JSON printer - 0.9 mm nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
G90
M83
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
G28
M107
machine_end_gcode:
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 2} F720
M104 S0
M140 S0
M107
M84
